mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as it signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers the discount rate for equity valuation, increasing the present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (historical median), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as measured by the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 250 indicates persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through improved corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong job growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing and industrial activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising (monthly change > 0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's tightening policy suppresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 250 signal a monetary tightening cycle amid high inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days through reduced risk appetite and higher real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
